title: Tokenized stock holders more than double as monthly volume surges
summary: Tokenized equities reached 1.31 million holders over the past month, as monthly transfer volume surged 179% to $23.13 billion and distributed value rose 5.9% to $2.38 billion.

title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Bitcoin to $1M by 2030 is ‘mathematically impossible’ says Markus Thielen
summary: The trillions required to boost Bitcoin to a price of $1 million per coin is not going to happen by 2030... or perhaps ever, says party pooper Markus Thielen.

title: Bitcoin could bottom in October, altcoins are ‘basically dead,’ Swan CEO says
summary: Klippsten said Bitcoin could bottom about a year after its previous peak and argued that crypto’s best outcome is to become part of TradFi.

title: Kalshi ordered to stop broad range of prediction markets in Washington
summary: Kalshi must implement initial geofencing by Aug. 19 and a GeoComply multi-source geofencing system by Sept. 2.

title: Galaxy lowers CLARITY Act odds to 10%
summary: Galaxy cited unresolved ethics, stablecoin yield and developer protection issues, along with a narrow Senate window when lawmakers return in September.

title: Gen Z favors ETFs and trades less than older cohorts: Binance
summary: Binance data showed Gen Z allocating a growing share of equity activity to ETFs while trading less frequently and using less leverage than older working-age cohorts.

title: Ireland plans industry standards for illicit crypto use
summary: The proposed policies under Ireland’s AML framework included stricter measures on transfers from private crypto wallets and overseas digital asset companies.

title: Dartmouth endowment’s crypto exposure drops by $2M amid falling prices
summary: The value of the university endowment’s holdings in the Bitwise Solana staking ETF, Grayscale Ethereum staking ETF and BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin ETF dropped to about $12 million.

title: Kraken parent Payward revenue rises 17% as trading volume falls in Q2
summary: Payward grew revenue despite weaker crypto spot activity, as funded accounts jumped 42% and a growing share of revenue came from outside transaction-based activity.
